sources.title: Building more with GPT-5.1-Codex-Max
sources.evidence: Dated November 19, 2025. Explicitly releases Max in Codex that day while API access is forthcoming. Describes coding-agent training, compaction across context windows and reasoning-effort settings; contains no numerical parameter count.

sources.title: API changelog
sources.evidence: Directly fetched Markdown. December 4, 2025 entry explicitly releases gpt-5.1-codex-max to the Responses API; separates this later milestone from Codex availability.

sources.title: GPT-5.1-Codex-Max API model documentation
sources.evidence: Exact model Markdown documents 400,000 context, 128,000 maximum output, text/image input, text output, reasoning tokens, function calling, prompt caching and Responses-only support. The only listed snapshot is the undated alias; status is shut down.

sources.title: GPT-5.1-Codex-Max System Card
sources.evidence: Full PDF text searched and relevant introduction/training/evaluation passages inspected. Its cover is November 18, 2025, not proof of public availability that day. Describes native training for compaction and coding tasks; no total/active parameter count or detailed layer/expert architecture is disclosed.

sources.title: Prompt Caching 201
sources.evidence: Directly fetched archived guide explicitly applies to models before GPT-5.6. Explains prompt caching using Transformer attention key/value projections and cached tensors across layers/heads; used with exact Max caching support for a limited operational inference.

sources.title: File inputs
sources.evidence: Directly fetched guide documents Responses PDF processing for vision models: extracted text and page images enter the model. This establishes an API input format rather than an additional native sensory modality.

sources.title: API deprecations
sources.evidence: Directly fetched April 22, 2026 notice explicitly lists gpt-5.1-codex-max for API shutdown on July 23, 2026. Current model documentation agrees.

sources.title: Addendum to GPT-5.2 System Card: GPT-5.2-Codex
sources.evidence: Later first-party card contains exact gpt-5.1-codex-max columns in Tables 1, 2 and 4 and further capability comparisons. Full text was searched for structural/count disclosures; the tables report evaluation results rather than model parameter totals or active counts.

sources.title: A Practical Approach to Verifying Code at Scale
sources.evidence: December 1, 2025 training research explicitly includes gpt-5.1-codex-max in its discussion of code-review training. Distinguishes review/generation tasks on the same underlying model. It does not disclose numerical model size, expert routing or a complete block inventory; figure labels naming original Codex are not transferred to Max.

sources.title: OpenAI Services Agreement
sources.evidence: Current section 9.1 reserves service intellectual-property rights and grants limited use rights. Supports a descriptive proprietary service classification, not an open-weight license or an assertion about the exact launch-day contract.

sources.title: All OpenAI API models
sources.evidence: Directly fetched catalog lists Max as a retired hosted model, separately from its explicitly identified Apache-2.0 open-weight gpt-oss models.

name.note: Official exact model name, including its published hyphens.

developer.note: The first-party announcement and model documentation identify OpenAI.

family.note: Generation-specific GPT-5.1 family; Max remains distinct from original Codex and Codex mini.

release_date.note: Earliest explicit public availability is November 19 in Codex. API access followed December 4; the November 18 system-card cover is not a public-release statement. Replaces the original Codex variant date.

open_weights.note: Documented distribution is hosted Codex/API service access. Reviewed primary sources offer no Max weight artifact and separately identify open-weight models.

license.note: Descriptive classification of hosted model access and retained service rights, not an SPDX or downloadable-weight license.

parameters_b.note: No total parameter count is disclosed in exact model documentation, original system card, later exact-Max comparison tables or code-review training research. Max naming, token efficiency and inference duration do not establish model size.

active_parameters_b.note: No per-token active parameter count or expert-routing specification is disclosed in the checked primary sources. No total-to-active equivalence or sibling transfer is assumed.

architecture.note: Qualified operational cross-source inference: exact Max documentation enables prompt_caching and OpenAI's applicable pre-GPT-5.6 guide explains Transformer attention KV caching. This does not establish exclusively Transformer blocks, dimensions, dense/MoE topology or numerical size. Inspected training research does not disclose those details.

context_window.note: Exact documented context window, distinct from 128,000 maximum output. Compaction continues a task across successive windows; millions of cumulative task tokens do not imply a million-token window. No input maximum is derived by subtraction.

modalities.note: Native input is text/image and output is text. PDF records the supported Responses API file format processed into text/page images for vision models; absence of a file_uploads feature flag is not a documented denial. No native audio/video or image output is inferred.

reasoning.note: Exact model supports reasoning tokens; the original release explicitly discusses medium and xhigh reasoning efforts. Compaction and longer tasks are not parameter-count evidence.

tool_call.note: The exact model page explicitly supports function calling in the Responses API; this does not imply availability of every hosted tool.

description.value: GPT-5.1 coding model trained for work across successive context windows, with reasoning, text and image input, and function calling.
description.note: Uses documented training and capabilities without benchmark superlatives or unsupported task claims.

sources.label: Addendum to GPT-5.2 System Card: GPT-5.2-Codex
A Practical Approach to Verifying Code at Scale

patch.notes: GPT-5.1-Codex-Max first became available in Codex on November 19, 2025; Responses API access followed December 4. The system-card cover date, November 18, does not establish public release. The model documentation lists only the undated alias, with no dated immutable snapshot. Its context window is 400,000 tokens and maximum output is 128,000; compaction across successive windows enables longer cumulative tasks without enlarging a single context window. PDF input denotes API conversion into text and page images. Transformer is a qualified inference from exact Max prompt-caching support and the applicable attention-KV mechanism; complete block inventory, dense/MoE routing and total/active parameter counts remain undisclosed in the checked primary sources. API access shut down on July 23, 2026; these are last-documented capabilities, not a claim of current endpoint operation.

summary: Corrected original public release from November 13 to November 19, 2025, with December 4 API release separately noted. Corrected name/family and license, added API PDF input and qualified Transformer inference, and replaced generic copy. Confirmed 400K context, reasoning and functions; distinguished multi-window compaction from context size. Counts remain undisclosed after original/later reports and training research. Recorded July 23, 2026 shutdown.
